output.summary: KEP-2238 adds an optional probe.terminationGracePeriodSeconds field so liveness and startup probe failures can use a grace period separate from the pod-level terminationGracePeriodSeconds, while readiness probes ignore it. The KEP is marked implementable at stable stage.
output.rationale: Liveness probe failures currently wait for the full pod terminationGracePeriodSeconds, so a wedged container with a long grace period is not restarted promptly. The proposal decouples the two by adding an optional per-probe field that defaults to current behaviour. Reviewers required a feature gate and off-by-default rollout because of API server and kubelet version skew, and raised concerns about breaking apps that rely on the grace period for crash safety.

alternatives.option: Infer the grace period from failure threshold times probe period
alternatives.why_not: Discussion listed cons: the default becomes implicit and arbitrary, and it complicates a later explicit API field. Users who want liveness to take longer would see behaviour change.

alternatives.option: Introduce a toleration similar to the node not-ready execute toleration
alternatives.why_not: Listed as a hack to avoid an API change; tolerations for execution were judged not to fit conditional probe behaviour.

alternatives.option: Terminate the pod immediately, or after a default grace period, on liveness failure
alternatives.why_not: Listed cons: may break applications that rely on the grace period for crash safety, thresholds are not user-configurable, and a feature flag would eventually become required behaviour.

alternatives.option: Add a pod-level field next to terminationGracePeriodSeconds
alternatives.why_not: Listed con: liveness probes act per container, so different containers may need different thresholds. Reviewers also raised this, and the KEP kept the field on the probe.

evidence.quote: I propose adding a new field to probes, `probe.terminationGracePeriodSeconds`. When set, it will override the `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` for liveness or startup termination
If the field is not specified, we will default to the current behaviour, which uses the `terminationGracePeriodSeconds`.
I think this requires a feature gate, and should not be treated different than any other change.
it needs to be off-by default for at least 2 releases until all kubelets are up to same level as API server.
liveness probes don't act at the pod level, they act exclusively at the container level.
